8.text: to their followers in order to make them distinguishable from ordinary people.

9.text: This, however, is applied only to the men. As far as I know, also among the

10.text: other neighboring tribes, female shamans have no external marks, nor do they

11.text: use the special shamanistic garb, which is assigned only to the male shamans.

12.text: In contrast to this is the custom, which I have spoken of among Chukchee

13.text: shamans, of adopting the clothes and the ways of a woman.
